title: Peddy Turned Teddy Into a Cat!
custom_script:
# Scene: living room
Peddy: {walk-to} Teddy, watch my new *magic trick*! I learned it from a book! {idea} [excited, point, shout, ding]
Teddy: {hmm} Last time you burned my socks. Fine, but only one try. [suspicious, hips]
Peddy: Abra-ka-dabra! {turn:Teddy:cat} [excited, point, shout, magic]
Teddy: {meow} Meow?! Peddy, I have a TAIL! And whiskers! [surprised, shrug, shout]
Peddy: {laugh} You look so cute! Can I keep you? {clap} [happy, wave, laugh]
Teddy: {angry} This is not funny! Turn me back right now! [angry, hips, shout]
Peddy: {oops} Umm… I only read the first page of the book. [surprised, shrug]
# Scene: neighbourhood
Dog: {show:dog} {bark} Woof! A cat! Come here, little kitty! [excited, point, shout]
Teddy: {scared} {run} Peddy, help! The dog wants to chase me! [surprised, shrug, shout, scream]
Dog: {chase} I just want to play! Woof woof! [happy, wave, footsteps]
Teddy: {hide} Peddy, read the second page! FAST! [angry, hips, shout]
Peddy: {oops} Okay, okay! Abra-ka-BACK! {turn:Teddy:back} [surprised, point, magic]
Dog: {shock} Where did the cat go? {walk-out} [surprised, shrug]
# Scene: living room (sitting)
Teddy: {sigh} Finally. I'm me again. No more magic, ever. [sad, idle, calm]
Peddy: {smile} Deal. Sorry, Teddy. Want some milk? [happy, wave]
Teddy: {nod} Yes please… {meow} Meow! [happy, idle]
Peddy: {gasp} {facepalm} Oh no… not again! [surprised, facepalm, fail]
